Agent.description: An LLM agent loop with tools and optional context block.

durable.description: Optional durable-execution config (ADR-0053). `None` => not durable (whole-bundle reentrant only). `Some` opts the agent into turn-level checkpoint/resume. `skip_serializing_if` keeps non-durable agents byte-stable with pre-A-minimal modules.

model_ref.description: Resolved model selection (backend + vendor id), baked at lowering.

output_schema.description: Optional JSON schema describing the agent's structured output. Plumbed from `[agents.<id>].output_schema`; consumed by a later judge-compat build-time check. `skip_serializing_if` keeps schema-less agents byte-stable.

produces.description: Artifact loci this agent declares it produces (deliverable binding).

tool_refs.description: Tools this agent is allowed to call.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens (input + output) the agent may consume across the entire run. `None` defers.

max_turns.description: Maximum number of turns the agent loop may take. `None` defers to the runtime default.

AgentId.description: Identifier for an [`crate::Agent`] node within a [`crate::Workflow`].

Backoff.description: Backoff parameters. Durations are stored as the author's verbatim duration strings (e.g. `"30s"`, `"10m"`) — they are host-honoured metadata, not values the (no_std) IR interpreter ever computes with.

max.description: Cap on the computed delay, duration string (e.g. `"10m"`).

oneOf.description: Constant delay between attempts.
Exponentially increasing delay, capped at `Backoff::max`.

CapabilityRequirements.description:
The capability-requirement set for one tool.

Re-export shape over `Vec<tau_domain::Capability>` — the IR does not re-define what a capability *is*; it just carries the existing type across the boundary. Future evolution (capability narrowing in the IR pre-hash, etc.) lands here.

declared.description: Declared capabilities; order is taken from the source TOML verbatim (capability list order is taken from the source TOML verbatim; two permuted capability arrays produce different canonical bytes. If order-independent hashing becomes required, sort in the lowering parse stage — `Capability` needs `Ord` first.)

CapabilityTable.description:
Per-tool capability table for a `Workflow`.

Built by the lowering pass from per-tool TOML declarations; consumed by the capability-fit check (D-3b) and embedded in the bundle's `tau.caps` custom section (D-3).

Check.description: A postcondition evaluated at a point in the pipeline.

oneOf.description: Deterministic predicate over a read locus.
Produced artifact whose content an LLM judge evaluates.

CheckpointGranularity.description:
Checkpoint granularity.

A-minimal ships `PerTurn` (commit after each completed turn, at-least-once for the crashed turn) and `PerToolCall` (narrower at-least-once window within a turn). Finer granularities are additive.

oneOf.description: Commit a checkpoint after each completed turn.

Commit a checkpoint after each completed tool call within a turn. Narrows (does not close) the at-least-once window — exactly-once stays A-full's job. Resume re-dispatches only the tools that had not completed before the crash (ADR-0053 follow-up).

ContextConfig.description:
β.4 context-manager configuration attached to an [`crate::node::Agent`].

`None` on the agent means "no context management" (full history every turn — pre-β.4 behavior). An empty `pipeline` serializes to `{}` so a `Some(ContextConfig::default())` is byte-identical to the legacy empty placeholder.

pipeline.description: Ordered transformers, applied top-to-bottom each turn. The last step must be the builtin `fit_budget` (typecheck-enforced).

ContextNodeKind.description: Delivery vehicle for a context node.

oneOf.description: A tau-provided builtin transformer.

A user-supplied node resolved at runtime. `source` selects the lane.

See: [escape-hatches.md#contextnodekind-custom](../../docs/explanation/escape-hatches.md#contextnodekind-custom).

ContextStep.description: One node in a context pipeline.

determinism.description: Author-declared determinism class. Gates β.6 conformance and what `TransformCx` exposes at runtime.

kind.description: Whether this is a builtin or a user-supplied custom node.

transformer.description: Transformer name. For builtins: `trim_old`, `compact_tool_outputs`, `fit_budget`. For custom nodes: the user-chosen step name.

DeterminismClass.description: Determinism class shared by the IR (this enum) and the runtime trait (`tau_runtime_core::context::ContextTransformer::determinism`). Defined here so both crates use one definition (no drift).

oneOf.description: Pure function of (messages, config); v1's three transformers.
Calls an `LlmBackend` (β.4.3); conformance-gated via cassette replay.
Reads/writes a memory store (β.4.4); excluded from the conformance gate.

fn_ref.description: Reference to the statically linked Rust function.

Durability.description:
Durable-execution config attached to an [`crate::node::Agent`].

Either a high-level **intent** (the host picks granularity + store per target — EPIC 6.1) or the **explicit** A-minimal form (ADR-0053). Absent (`None` on the agent) is byte-stable with pre-A-minimal modules.

oneOf.description: High-level intent. The host resolves it to a concrete granularity + store for the run/build target (see `tau_runtime_core::durable_resolve`).
Explicit escape hatch: the author names the mechanism directly.

checkpoint.description: How often a checkpoint is committed.

DurabilityIntent.description:
High-level durability intent. The host sizes it per target.

`#[non_exhaustive]`: more intents are additive `MINOR` `ir_format` bumps.

oneOf.description: "This run must survive a process restart." Resolves per target to the coarsest checkpoint + store the target can durably provide.

DurableStore.description:
Where durable state is written.

A-minimal ships only `File` (`./.tau/runs/<run_id>/turn-<n>.json`). `Kv` (an MCP-contracted journal — never a built-in DB, per NG6) is an additive follow-up belonging to A-full.

oneOf.description: Per-turn snapshot files under `.tau/runs/<run_id>/`.
Locus resolves.
Resolves and non-empty.
Equals the literal.
Matches the regex.
At least N items.
Validates against the JSON schema.
Registered native fn.

IrFormatVersion.description:
Semver-shaped IR format version (D-6).

Bumps follow semver rules: - MAJOR for breaking shape changes (removed node type, removed required field, changed lowering contract). - MINOR for additive changes (new optional field, new variant of a `#[non_exhaustive]` enum). - PATCH for spec-only edits with no IR-shape effect.

IrModule.description:
The container for one workflow's IR.

`tau build` emits one `IrModule` per workflow (one per project for v0). `tau verify --bundle` re-builds and asserts byte-equality of the canonical form (D-6).

target.description: Target triple this module was lowered for.

tau_version.description: tau compiler binary version that emitted this module. Semver-shaped (e.g. `"0.X.Y"`).

triggers.description: Trigger bindings — invocation metadata, a SIBLING of `workflow` (triggers are about *how* tau is invoked, not the call graph). `skip_serializing_if` + `default` means a trigger-less module emits no `triggers` key and hashes identically to a pre-trigger module (Option B / ADR-0044 §D1); older modules with no key read back as empty.

oneOf.description: The canonical judge, on a build-time-resolved model.

model_ref.description: Resolved model (alias resolved + producer-default applied at lowering).

oneOf.description: A user `[agents.*]` used as judge.
Filesystem path.
Named pipeline-step output (`steps.<id>.output`).

backend.description: Backend package name — the key the runtime resolves a backend by.

NativeFnRef.description:
A reference to a statically linked native tool by symbolic name.

The symbolic name (e.g. `"ReadTemp"`) is the Rust identifier of the `impl Tool for X` type. The lowering pass resolves it against the project's native tool registry; AOT (β.7) lowers the call site directly. v0's interpreter dispatches by name through a `NativeFnRegistry` injected at runtime.

name.description: Symbolic name of the Rust `Tool` impl.

oneOf.description: Exit non-zero with the rationale.
Rewind to the gate and re-run forward.

Pipeline.description: An ordered, engine-sequenced pipeline of steps.

steps.description: Steps, executed top-to-bottom in this order.

id.description: Handle for this step; its output is addressable as `steps.<id>.output` by later steps.

PipelineStepId.description: Identifier for a [`crate::pipeline::PipelineStep`] within a [`crate::Workflow`]'s pipeline. Addressable as `steps.<id>.output`.

RetryPolicy.description: Trigger-level re-invocation policy. This is **not** a per-node interpreter retry: the host (or host adapter) re-invokes the artifact; tau's interpreter stays deterministic and stateless across invocations.

dead_letter.description: Where a run that exhausts `max_attempts` is sent — a **sink reference** (`mcp:<name>` or an already-granted capability target), never a tau-owned queue. `None` ⇒ no dead-letter sink. The envelope shape is a runtime concern not modelled in slice 1 (see ADR-0044 §D2).

max_attempts.description: Total attempts including the first; `1` = no retry.

gate.description: Rewind point — at or before the producer step.

StepId.description: Identifier for a [`crate::Deterministic`] step within a [`crate::Workflow`].

StepRun.description: What a [`PipelineStep`] executes — a reference to an existing node.

oneOf.description: Run an agent node by id.
Invoke a tool node by id.
Run a deterministic step node by id.

Evaluate a postcondition check by id.

The referenced [`CheckId`](crate::ids::CheckId) must exist in `workflow.checks`; this is enforced by the typecheck stage. Runtime evaluation is implemented in `tau-runtime-core`'s pipeline executor (Task 19).

SubflowEdge.description: A subflow edge in a workflow.

id.description: Identifier of this subflow within the workflow.

SubflowId.description: Identifier for a [`crate::Subflow`] edge within a [`crate::Workflow`].

oneOf.description: Spawn a sibling agent within the same module with a narrowed capability set. Per the subset-of-parent rule, `cap_subset` MUST be a subset of the parent agent's grant; the lowering pass checks this.

cap_subset.description: Capability subset granted to the child.

oneOf.description: Compose another full workflow as a subroutine. Used for pipeline composition; v0 reserves the variant but the lowering pass currently rejects it pending the multi-workflow framing in a future spec.

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities. Used by the capability-fit check (D-3b) and by the runtime gate.

impl_.description: How the tool's behavior is provided.

spec.description: Tool specification (name, description, input schema) used by the LLM to decide when to call the tool.

ToolId.description: Identifier for a [`crate::Tool`] node within a [`crate::Workflow`].

ToolImpl.description: How a [`crate::Tool`] node's behavior is provided at runtime.

oneOf.description: Statically linked native tool.

content_hash.description: Hash of the impl's source bytes (Rust source, dependencies' content hashes). Participates in the IR module hash.

fn_ref.description: Reference to the native Rust impl by symbolic name.

oneOf.description: MCP-contracted external server.

capability_subset.description: The subset of capabilities this MCP server is bounded to (a subset of the contract's declared capabilities; narrowed by `tau.toml` overrides).

contract_hash.description: Content hash of the MCP contract (the cached schema + capability declaration the server advertises at handshake). Participates in the IR module hash so a contract drift invalidates the bundle.

server_tool_name.description: The name passed on the MCP wire (server-side tool name). Differs from this `Tool` node's `ToolId` because lowering expands one author-side entry (`weather`) into N IR nodes (`weather.get_forecast`, `weather.get_current`, ...); each expanded node carries the server-side name to forward on `tools/call` requests.

oneOf.description:
Sub-workflow spawn: invoking this tool runs the named agent (in the same `IrModule`) as a child loop with empty initial history. The child's final assistant text (or empty string) becomes the tool result body.

v0 limitation: tool input args are NOT forwarded to the child as a User message — the child runs with empty initial messages and its own prompt + LLM script drive its behavior. β.7 (AOT codegen) is the natural place to thread arg-forwarding.

Deterministic step: invoking this tool calls the pure Rust function named by the step's `fn_ref` via the dispatcher's `deterministic_registry()`. The function's return value becomes the tool result body. No LLM, no I/O.

ToolSpec.description:
Tool specification surface used by the agent loop.

Mirror of `tau_ports::ToolSpec` adapted for IR storage. Provides the LLM-facing schema; not used for capability decisions.

input_schema.description: JSON schema for the tool's input.

TriggerBinding.description:
One named trigger binding. Canonically ordered by `name` within `IrModule.triggers`. A trigger is metadata about how tau is invoked, never an executable node.

Optional fields serialize verbatim (`None` → `null`, no skipping) to match the IR's canonical-encoding discipline (see `canonical.rs`). Only the module-level `triggers` `Vec` skips-when-empty, to preserve trigger-less hashes.

agent.description: Entrypoint agent id (validated at lowering against the workflow).

kind.description: The kind of event this binds to.

retry.description: Re-invocation policy (`None` = invoke once, no retry).

timezone.description: IANA timezone name; defaults to `"UTC"` at config-validation time (cron kind only).

TriggerKind.description: The kind of external event a trigger binds to.

oneOf.description: Fires on a cron schedule. Substrate = systemd/k8s/Lambda scheduler.
The default: tau is invoked by an external driver (a parent process, CI step, etc.). No scheduler descriptor is emitted.

Workflow.description: The set of nodes + edges that make up one workflow.

capability_table.description: Per-tool capability requirements. Derived from `tools` but stored explicitly for the bundle's `tau.caps` custom section.

checks.description: Postcondition checks, keyed by id. Positioned in the pipeline via `StepRun::Check`.

pipeline.description: Optional engine-sequenced pipeline. `None` preserves single-entry behavior (run the named entry agent). `Some` => `run_pipeline`.

description:
The container for one workflow's IR.

`tau build` emits one `IrModule` per workflow (one per project for v0). `tau verify --bundle` re-builds and asserts byte-equality of the canonical form (D-6).

target.description: Target triple this module was lowered for.

tau_version.description: tau compiler binary version that emitted this module. Semver-shaped (e.g. `"0.X.Y"`).

triggers.description: Trigger bindings — invocation metadata, a SIBLING of `workflow` (triggers are about *how* tau is invoked, not the call graph). `skip_serializing_if` + `default` means a trigger-less module emits no `triggers` key and hashes identically to a pre-trigger module (Option B / ADR-0044 §D1); older modules with no key read back as empty.
